name: GLM-5.3-Flash NVFP4（TP=2 · DFlash2 · 262K）
description: GLM-5.3-Flash（320B/A18B MoE，glm5_next）NVFP4 双节点 TP=2 服务（fp8 KV + DFlash2 块扩散投机）：上游「the one to copy」档位——C1–C6 并发扫描零失败、warm 单流 46.9 tok/s（74.1% 接受率，结构化 54–61 tok/s）、262,144 上下文、KV 让 profiler 定池（581,040-token，勿 pin）；v11-dflash2 镜像（与 TP4 DFlash2 同链烘焙）+ 默认 RedHatAI/GLM-5.3-Flash-NVFP4 checkpoint（compressed-tensors，修复 ModelOpt token 损坏）。
compose_template:
services:
  vllm-glm53:
    image: ${GLM53_IMAGE:-registry.cn-shanghai.aliyuncs.com/aixn-public/glm53-flash-sm121:v11-dflash2}
    container_name: ${TASK_NAME}-rank${NODE_RANK}
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "python3", "-c", "import urllib.request,sys; sys.exit(0 if urllib.request.urlopen('http://127.0.0.1:${VLLM_PORT:-8000}/health', timeout=5).status == 200 else 1)"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 3
      start_period: 900s
    pull_policy: if_not_present
    entrypoint: []
    network_mode: host
    ipc: host
    shm_size: "32gb"
    ulimits:
      memlock: -1
      stack: 67108864
      nofile: 1048576
    gpus: all
    devices:
      - /dev/infiniband:/dev/infiniband
    volumes:
      # 生产 launcher 把权重挂在 /cache/huggingface（HF_HOME 指向它）
      - ${HF_CACHE:-${HOME}/.cache/huggingface}:/cache/huggingface
    environment:
      HF_HOME: /cache/huggingface
      HF_HUB_OFFLINE: "1"  # 模型由管理平台分发到节点缓存，固定离线加载
      HF_HUB_DISABLE_XET: "${HF_HUB_DISABLE_XET:-1}"
      TRANSFORMERS_OFFLINE: "1"
      VLLM_ENGINE_READY_TIMEOUT_S: "3600"
      # Triton / FlashInfer JIT 编译缓存挂已持久化的 HF 缓存内，容器重建不丢
      TRITON_CACHE_DIR: "${TRITON_CACHE_DIR:-/cache/huggingface/.tritoncache-glm53}"
      FLASHINFER_JIT_CACHE_DIR: "${FLASHINFER_JIT_CACHE_DIR:-/cache/huggingface/.flashinfer-glm53}"
      # SM121 架构 + fp8 KV 所需（源 launcher 全部保留）
      TORCH_CUDA_ARCH_LIST: "12.1a"
      FLASHINFER_CUDA_ARCH_LIST: "12.1a"
      FLASHINFER_DISABLE_VERSION_CHECK: "1"
      PYTORCH_CUDA_ALLOC_CONF: expandable_segments:True
      VLLM_HOST_IP: "${VLLM_HOST_IP:-}"
      # 网络：RoCE，HCA 由 hca 自动键逗号分隔填充；GID 每启动动态解析
      NCCL_NET: "${NCCL_NET:-IB}"
      NCCL_IB_DISABLE: "0"
      NCCL_IB_HCA: "${NCCL_IB_HCA:-}"
      NCCL_IB_GID_INDEX: "${NCCL_IB_GID_INDEX:-}"
      NCCL_IB_GID_AUTO: "1"
      NCCL_IB_ADDR_FAMILY: AF_INET
      NCCL_IB_ROCE_VERSION_NUM: 2
      NCCL_SOCKET_IFNAME: "${NCCL_SOCKET_IFNAME:-}"
      GLOO_SOCKET_IFNAME: "${GLOO_SOCKET_IFNAME:-${NCCL_SOCKET_IFNAME}}"
      NCCL_NVLS_ENABLE: "0"
      NCCL_CROSS_NIC: "0"
      NCCL_IB_MERGE_NICS: "0"
      NCCL_CUMEM_ENABLE: "0"
      NCCL_IGNORE_CPU_AFFINITY: "1"
      NCCL_DEBUG: WARN
      TORCH_NCCL_ASYNC_ERROR_HANDLING: "1"
    command:
      - bash
      - -lc
      - >
        export PATH="/usr/local/cuda/bin:/usr/local/bin:$${PATH:-}";
        export CUDA_HOME="$${CUDA_HOME:-/usr/local/cuda}";
        export CUDA_PATH="$${CUDA_PATH:-$${CUDA_HOME}}";
        export CUDAToolkit_ROOT="$${CUDAToolkit_ROOT:-$${CUDA_HOME}}";
        export LD_LIBRARY_PATH="/usr/local/cuda/lib64:$${LD_LIBRARY_PATH:-}";
        exec /usr/local/bin/vllm serve ${GLM53_MODEL_PATH:-RedHatAI/GLM-5.3-Flash-NVFP4}
        --served-model-name ${SERVED_MODEL_NAME:-glm-5.3-flash}
        --host ${VLLM_HOST:-0.0.0.0}
        --port ${VLLM_PORT:-8000}
        --trust-remote-code
        --tensor-parallel-size 2
        --gpu-memory-utilization ${GPU_MEMORY_UTILIZATION:-0.85}
        --max-model-len ${MAX_MODEL_LEN:-262144}
        --max-num-seqs ${MAX_NUM_SEQS:-6}
        --block-size 2304
        --moe-backend marlin
        --speculative-config '{"method":"dflash","model":"${GLM53_DRAFT_PATH:-incoai/GLM-5.3-Flash-DFlash2}","num_speculative_tokens":${DFLASH2_NUM_SPECULATIVE_TOKENS:-7}}'
        --kv-cache-dtype fp8_e4m3
        ${KV_CACHE_MEMORY:+--kv-cache-memory ${KV_CACHE_MEMORY}}
        --enforce-eager
        --enable-prefix-caching
        --enable-prompt-tokens-details
        --tool-call-parser glm47
        --enable-auto-tool-choice
        --reasoning-parser glm45
        --default-chat-template-kwargs '{"enable_thinking": false}'
        ${CHAT_TEMPLATE:+--chat-template ${CHAT_TEMPLATE}}
        --distributed-executor-backend mp
        --nnodes ${NODES_TOTAL:-2}
        --node-rank ${NODE_RANK}
        --master-addr ${MASTER_ADDR}
        --master-port ${MASTER_PORT:-29521}
        ${HEADLESS:+--headless}

variables.label: vLLM 镜像
variables.help: 阿里云 ACR 平台镜像（与 TP4 DFlash2 配方同一镜像）：按上游公开 GHCR 链（ghcr.io/tonyd2wild/vllm-glm53-flash:sm121-v11-dflash2 = day-0 + v1→v9 九层 patch 栈 + DFlash2 overlay）烘焙，另在镜像内烘焙 SM121 sparse_attn_indexer_kpool 模块（上游由 launcher 运行时 bind-mount 的同一文件，平台无法分发主机文件，故打入镜像）与 mm chat 模板
variables.help_en: Aliyun ACR platform image (the same one the TP4 DFlash2 recipe uses): baked from the public upstream GHCR chain (ghcr.io/tonyd2wild/vllm-glm53-flash:sm121-v11-dflash2 = day-0 + the v1→v9 nine-layer patch stack + the DFlash2 overlay); additionally bakes the SM121 sparse_attn_indexer_kpool module (the same file upstream bind-mounts at launch — the platform cannot distribute host files, so it is baked) and the mm chat template

variables.label: 模型路径
variables.help: 主模型默认 RedHatAI/GLM-5.3-Flash-NVFP4（compressed-tensors，drop-in 无 flag 改动，加载快 ~2×）：修复 ModelOpt 构建的间歇性 token 损坏（vLLM #54150）。ModelOpt 版仍可用但带损坏：censored LibertAIDAI/GLM-5.3-Flash-NVFP4（120 分片 ~182GiB）、uncensored drowzeys/keys-GLM-5.3-Flash-NVFP4-ablit-l15-45-anchorstock（同 launcher 已验证）；也可填缓存内 snapshot 绝对路径
variables.help_en: Main model defaults to RedHatAI/GLM-5.3-Flash-NVFP4 (compressed-tensors, drop-in with zero flag changes, loads ~2x faster): fixes the intermittent token corruption of ModelOpt builds (vLLM #54150). ModelOpt builds remain usable but corrupted: censored LibertAIDAI/GLM-5.3-Flash-NVFP4 (120 shards ~182 GiB), uncensored drowzeys/keys-GLM-5.3-Flash-NVFP4-ablit-l15-45-anchorstock (verified on the same launcher); or use an absolute snapshot path in the cache

variables.label: DFlash2 Drafter 模型
variables.help: DFlash2 块扩散草稿模型（qwen3 架构，5 层 SWA，dflash_config block_size=8 / selector_rank=256 / target_layer_ids [5,14,24,33,42]，单文件 model.safetensors 2.34GB）；与主模型一样由平台分发到节点 HF 缓存，容器内按 repo id 离线解析（HF_HOME=/cache/huggingface）
variables.help_en: DFlash2 block-diffusion draft model (qwen3 arch, 5 SWA layers, dflash_config block_size=8 / selector_rank=256 / target_layer_ids [5,14,24,33,42], single model.safetensors 2.34GB); distributed to the node HF cache like the main model and resolved offline by repo id (HF_HOME=/cache/huggingface)

variables.label: 最大上下文长度
variables.help: 上游已验证的「one to copy」档位：262,144（TP2 每 rank ~97GiB 权重，勿上 1M）
variables.help_en: The upstream-validated "one to copy" value: 262,144 (TP2 carries ~97 GiB weights/rank; do not use 1M)

variables.label: 最大并发序列数
variables.help: 源 launcher 生产 6（TP2 每 rank ~97GiB 权重）
variables.help_en: Upstream launcher production value 6 (TP2 ~97 GiB weights/rank)

variables.label: GPU 显存利用率
variables.help: 上游生产 0.85（0.78–0.80 在 131K+ 会饿死 KV 池）；配合 profiler 定池，改动请先用真实长 prefill 把关
variables.help_en: Upstream production 0.85 (0.78-0.80 starves the KV cache at 131K+); pairs with the profiler-sized pool — gate any change behind a real long prefill

variables.label: 固定 KV 预算（字节；留空 = profiler 定池）
variables.help: 默认留空 = **不传 --kv-cache-memory，让 profiler 定池**（上游验证：DFlash2 + fp8 KV @262K = 581,040-token 池，28,818-token 深 prompt 存活）。**勿 pin**：一旦传值，vLLM 仍跑 profile 但从不扣激活峰值（util 失效），分配/预热/短答全过，第一个长 prompt 无地放激活即死（上游在 4 个不同 pin 上复现）。确要固定填字节数（如旧 3GiB = 3221225472）
variables.help_en: Leave empty (default) = do NOT pass --kv-cache-memory, let the profiler size the pool (upstream-verified: DFlash2 + fp8 KV @262K = 581,040-token pool, survived a 28,818-token deep prompt). Do not pin: with a pin vLLM still profiles but never subtracts the measured activation peak (util dies), allocation/warmup/short generations pass, then the first long prompt OOMs — reproduced at four different pins upstream. If you really must, set raw bytes (old 3 GiB = 3221225472)

variables.label: DFlash2 投机 token 数（block_size-1）
variables.help: 必须是 block_size-1=7：drafter 按 8 的 block 训练，末位是目标模型已验证 token；填 8 会草稿一个模型从未学过的位置
variables.help_en: Must be block_size-1=7: the drafter is trained for a block of 8 and the last position is the target's own verified token; 8 drafts a position the model never learned

variables.label: Chat 模板（含 Vision）
variables.help: 镜像内已烘焙 mm 模板（上游源仓库 chat_template_mm.jinja），默认即命中、Vision 直接可用（同时不投机）；填空则退回 checkpoint 自带 text-only 模板
variables.help_en: The mm template is baked into the image (chat_template_mm.jinja from the upstream repo) and is the default, so Vision works out of the box (it is just not speculated); empty falls back to the checkpoint's built-in text-only template

variables.label: Head 节点地址
variables.help: 自动填充 head 节点的 RoCE IP（多节点协调地址，随任务的 head 变化）
variables.help_en: Filled with the head node's RoCE IP (multi-node coordination address, follows per-task head)

variables.label: 节点总数
variables.help: 由任务节点数自动填充（本配方为固定 4 节点拓扑，发布时校验恰好匹配）
variables.help_en: Auto-filled from task node count (fixed 4-node topology; publish validates exact match)

variables.label: Headless（worker 不跑 API server）
variables.help: 自动按角色填充：head 为空、worker 为 1（mp 多节点协调必需）
variables.help_en: Auto-filled per role: empty on head, 1 on workers (required for mp multi-node coordination)

variables.label: 本节点 vLLM 绑定 IP
variables.help: 必须为各节点 RoCE IP，避免分布式绑定错误地址
variables.help_en: Must be each node's RoCE IP to avoid binding the wrong address

variables.label: RoCE HCA
variables.help: hca 自动键按节点返回逗号分隔多 rail（源单 rail：rocep1s0f0）
variables.help_en: The hca auto key returns comma-separated rails per node (upstream single-rail: rocep1s0f0)

variables.label: NCCL 网络接口
variables.help: auto 返回首选 RoCE 口；多 rail 场景可手工覆盖
variables.help_en: auto returns the preferred RoCE interface; override for multi-rail

variables.label: RoCE GID index
variables.help: 每节点/HCA 不同且重启漂移，自动解析（源 launcher 用固定 gid_index=3，本配方按节点动态解析）
variables.help_en: Per-node/per-HCA and drifts across reboots; auto-resolved (upstream hard-codes gid_index=3; this recipe resolves per node)

description_en: 2-node TP=2 serving for GLM-5.3-Flash (320B/A18B MoE, glm5_next) NVFP4 quant — fp8 KV + DFlash2 block-diffusion spec decode, the upstream 'the one to copy' tier: C1-C6 concurrency sweep with zero failures, warm single-stream 46.9 tok/s (74.1% acceptance; 54-61 tok/s structured), 262,144 context, KV pool profiler-sized (581,040 tokens — do not pin); v11-dflash2 image (same bake chain as the TP4 DFlash2 recipe) + default RedHatAI/GLM-5.3-Flash-NVFP4 checkpoint (compressed-tensors, fixes ModelOpt token corruption).
